title: File:Cultivating near Melton Ross - geograph.org.uk - 2106673.jpg
desc: Cultivating near Melton Ross, North Lincolnshire, Great Britain. The tractor is a John Deere 7530 towing a Simba CultiPress 4.6m (a set of cultivating tines followed by a levelling board and two rows of 600 mm DD press rings).

title: File:Drilling on Saxby Wolds 2.jpg
desc: Drilling on Saxby Wolds, England. The equipment used is a John Deere 7530 Premium tractor towing a Kverneland Pneumatic Accord DA-5 seed drill combined with a Maschio power harrow/cultivator; a packer with tine attachment at the front three-point linkage.
